name: Banh ep Cau Hai
summary: Bánh ép Cầu Hai is a pressed tapioca cake from the Phú Lộc lagoon, eaten hot. One account fills it with lean pork and shrimp and dips it in mắm nêm; another fills it with pork and dips it in mắm nêm or nước mắm.
origin: Đầm Cầu Hai, Phú Lộc, under Bạch Mã, about 45 km south of Huế.
texture: CafeBiz, Phùng Hà, 29 June 2022, describes a cake about the size of a palm, hot off a round iron mold, and chewy.
Đại Việt Tourist, Hằng Min, on 19 April 2025, calls the same cake thin and crisp.
taste: CafeBiz dips it in mắm nêm with garlic and chili, and says the cake carries lean pork and shrimp.
Đại Việt Tourist, on 15 August 2024, also dips it in mắm nêm. The 19 April 2025 account dips it in nước mắm with garlic and chili.
howToEat: Eat it hot. CafeBiz rolls it like bánh cuốn with lettuce, cucumber, split water spinach, banana blossom, herbs, and bean sprouts, then dips it in mắm nêm. The filling in that account is tapioca starch, lean pork, shrimp, and spring onion, pressed on a round iron mold over charcoal.
where: Phú Lộc, at the Cầu Hai lagoon.
seoTitle: Banh ep Cau Hai — pork, shrimp, and two dips
seoDescription: Bánh ép Cầu Hai is a hot pressed cake from the Phú Lộc lagoon, with pork and shrimp in one account and pork in another, dipped in mắm nêm or nước mắm.
